title: Instruction card (parsed)
description: The shared shape of a recipe card (recipes/<name>/<name>.card.md) and a tool card (tools/<pack>/tools/<name>.card.md). A card is Markdown, so this schema describes its PARSED form: the validators (scripts/validate-recipes.py, scripts/validate-tools.py) read the file, build an object of this shape, and check it. The card is the contract — an agent must be able to invoke the thing having read the card and nothing else, never the recipe.json and never the script. If the card and the artifact disagree, the card is the bug report.

name.description: The recipe or tool this card documents, taken from the filename.

title.description: The card's H1. Must be exactly '# <name>' — the card names one thing.

sections.description: The H2 headings in file order. Fixed order, nothing added or dropped: a reader who has learned one card has learned all of them.

lines.description: Non-blank-trailing line count. The cap is the point: a card longer than a screen stops being cheaper to read than the thing it documents.

invoke.description: The ## Invoke body: a fenced command line. A tool card writes the script's own position as the placeholder {script} — the CLI substitutes the materialised absolute path there, and a literal scripts/foo.py resolves only through a filename-guessing shim. Other placeholders are written {like-this}.

inputs.description: The ## Inputs body. Must document every input the artifact accepts, each as `name` in backticks: for a recipe, every declared and referenced {{var:}}; for a tool, every flag the script's own parser defines. An input absent here is an input the agent cannot know to pass.

outputs.description: The ## Outputs body: every file written, the stdout shape, and what each exit code means.
